result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Yusuf's asthma review appointment on Monday 9 November 2026 has been cancelled. The clinic has moved. He has a new appointment.

## What you need to do
1. Take Yusuf to his new appointment on Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15.
2. Bring all of Yusuf's inhalers. This includes his blue reliever inhaler (salbutamol) and his brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone).
3. Bring his spacer.
4. Bring his red book (personal child health record), if you have it.
5. Keep giving Yusuf his brown preventer inhaler every day, even when he is well.
6. If the new time is not suitable, call 01632 960 588.

## Dates and medicines
- Old appointment, cancelled: 9 November 2026.
- New appointment: Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15. You will see the Paediatric Asthma Nurse. It is in Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.
- Beclometasone (brown preventer inhaler): give it every day, even when he is well. The letter says to keep giving it.
- Salbutamol (blue reliever inhaler): bring it to the appointment.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Where is the clinic now?
- What will happen at the asthma review?
- Can we change the time if 09:15 is hard for us?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
